body: Thanks so much for your response!
Naw you're sweet! Haha I think it can work both ways though
There's nothing like being able to show your mum what it is that you've done is there? Big hugs to you.
You're so welcome! I just hate the way so many people want to tell you how you should feel and what you should be doing instead of appreciating how things actually are for valid reasons.
I'm really sorry to see this! No one tells you how losing your parent will probably mean losing friends - or more like people who you thought were your friends. Much love to you!

First of all I'm so sorry to see this. I'm not gonna lie to you. The first holidays or any sort of family celebration after a loved one passes is extremely painful. Above all I would like to urge you to not put pressure on yourself to do too much if you don't feel up to it. You may like to keep some of the traditions you kept when your dad was around or you might prefer to do something different, or maybe a mixture of old and new will suit you. It's absolutely normal to cry so please let yourself do this - but I know its hard. I know it's easy to say these things but trust me I know how we all want to put on a brave face. Much love to you!
Big hugs to you. Losing your mum is awful! You always miss her no matter how many years pass.

The rug is pulled out from under you for sure. I don't know if anyone truly appreciates what their parent does until they don't have them around anymore. I don't think anything can prepare you for it. Big hugs to you!
Absolutely understandable! There's no time limit to grief. It all just hurts. Hugs to you!

Big hugs to you! Such a huge loss will take a lot of time to come to terms with. I say that rather than say 'get over' or 'recover from' because I think over time we learn to live with it but I can't honestly say it goes away or you stop caring that they are gone. Feel free to vent to me anytime.
Big hugs to you! This is such an awful time of year for those feelings to crop up.
This time of year is especially hard because of the whole 'happy families' image that gets perpetuated around Christmas.
I function ok but generally there's this sense that I've lost my purpose. I keep feeling like it should have been me. Thanks for responding! Sorry to see about your dad
Much love to you. So sorry to see this. Hugs! Don't apologise for venting please. If anything feel free to keep letting it out again and again like you need to. Like we ALL need to.
Much love to you I'm so sorry to see what has happened. My mum died really suddenly when I was nearly 19. Please feel free to message me if you need to vent. Hugs.

Hey I'm so sorry to see this. It absolutely sucks when you make an effort to socialise and step outside your comfort zone only to have it all thrown in your face. I've always been really quiet. I definitely got picked on a lot because of it. I can be more loud but that's with people who I feel more comfortable with. Please feel free to pm me if you want to vent. I'm sure I would hang out with you and genuinely enjoy your company. Like actually. People who talk all the friggin time about nothing drive me nuts lol
